english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for putting enough contents into a container, or for saying that it ends up full.
Use 裝滿 as the all-purpose spoken choice for filling a container completely, including up to its brim.

examples.english: I’ll fill your water bottle with water.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 bong1 nei5 go3 seoi2 zeon1 zong1 mun5 seoi2

examples.english: The water bottle is filled to the brim with cold water.
examples.jyutping: go3 seoi2 zeon1 zong1 mun5 saai3 dung3 seoi2
